priority: Preserve functions and Home Assistant compatibility using finished modules on one direct-solder carrier.

assembly.method: Factory male module pins enter plated holes directly. Controllers face the room; Ethernet and male harness headers face the ceiling. Solder joints lie on the opposite face and require a checked access order.
assembly.new_recovery_contact: J8 and J9: unpopulated local recovery pads, normally open
assembly.h2_preparation: DevKitM-1 schematic v1.3: remove R7 (470 ohm) to isolate CP2102N TX; use H2 RX23/TX24
assembly.mounting: One H3 PCB retention hole plus split enclosure edge capture; separate enclosure ceiling attachment and WIZ jack stop
assembly.sequence: Program loose controllers; solder, trim and inspect all 13 rear parts before fitting the 3 front controllers. Measure residual overlap clearances.

release_policy: One current design does not imply a validated manufacturing release. Hardware operation, physical fit and simultaneous-load acceptance remain separate gates.

active_enclosure.status: carrier-only engineering prototype; physical fit, force, thermal and RF qualification outstanding
active_enclosure.floor_hardware_installation: Install and adjust on the bench before ceiling attachment; measured underside projection including washers must not exceed 3 mm.
active_enclosure.jack_stop: Contact coordinates are unqualified; adjust to measured metal cage without component or latch contact before use.
